meaning_ko: (가치·유용성이 유지되는) 수명, 유효 기간, (식품의) 유통 기한
example_en: Fresh milk has a very short shelf life.

meaning_ko: 단세포의, 세포 하나로 이루어진
example_en: Amoebas are single-celled organisms.

meaning_ko: (개 등이) 덥석 물려고 달려들었다, (사람에게) 쏘아붙였다 — snap at 의 과거형
example_en: The frightened dog snapped at my hand.

meaning_ko: 사회적으로 용인되는, 사회 통념에 맞는
example_en: Talking loudly in a library is not socially acceptable.

meaning_ko: 매진된, 다 팔린
example_en: Tickets for the concert were sold out in an hour.

meaning_ko: (방송용으로 따온) 짧고 인상적인 발언 토막
example_en: Politicians prepare a catchy sound-bite for the evening news.

meaning_ko: 공간 배치, 공간 구성
example_en: The spatial organization of a kitchen shapes how people cook in it.

meaning_ko: 공개적으로 반대 의견을 밝혔다, 소신을 말했다 — speak out 의 과거형
example_en: She spoke out against the new rule at the meeting.

meaning_ko: 넓이가 ~제곱피트인 (1제곱피트 ≈ 0.09㎡)
example_en: They moved into a 900-square-foot apartment.

meaning_ko: 무대 공포증, 사람들 앞에 설 때 느끼는 두려움
example_en: He still gets stage fright before every performance.

meaning_ko: 방해가 되다, 가로막다
example_en: Do not let fear stand in the way of your plans.

meaning_ko: 현재 상태, 현상(現狀), 기존 질서
example_en: New leaders are expected to challenge the status quo.

meaning_ko: (찻잎이) 잘 우러나는 정도, 우려내기 좋은 성질
example_en: The steepability of the leaves decides how quickly the tea brews.

meaning_ko: (밖으로) 튀어나와 있는, 삐져나와 있는 — stick out 의 진행형
example_en: A pencil was sticking out of his back pocket.

meaning_ko: 자극에 이끌리는, 눈앞의 자극에 그때그때 반응하는
example_en: Stimulus-driven attention jumps to whatever moves or flashes.

meaning_ko: 초전도체(전기 저항이 0인 물질) — superconductor 의 복수형
example_en: Superconductors carry electricity without losing energy.

meaning_ko: ~을 자기 공으로 돌리다, ~에 대해 칭찬을 받다
example_en: He tried to take credit for work the whole team had done.

meaning_ko: (일이) 일어나다, 열리다, 개최되다
example_en: The school festival will take place next Friday.

meaning_ko: (경험·강연에서 얻은) 핵심 교훈, 요점, (영국) 포장 음식
example_en: My main take-away from the lecture was to ask better questions.

meaning_ko: 시간 해상도(얼마나 자주 관측·기록되는지의 정밀도)
example_en: A satellite with high temporal resolution photographs the same area every day.

meaning_ko: 영역 지키기, 세력권 주장, (동물의) 텃세
example_en: Territoriality between departments slows down cooperation.

meaning_ko: 동점을 깨는, 승부를 가르는
example_en: She scored the tiebreaking goal in the last minute.

meaning_ko: (계획·효과가 미치는) 시간 범위, 기간
example_en: Investors with a long time horizon can accept short-term losses.

meaning_ko: ~을 불쌍히 여겼다 — take pity on 의 과거형
example_en: She took pity on the stray cat and fed it.

meaning_ko: 여행 상품을 기획·운영하는 업체, 여행사 — tour operator 의 복수형
example_en: Local tour operators arrange boat trips to the island.

meaning_ko: 시험 사용 가능성(새 방법을 작게 시험해 볼 수 있는 정도)
example_en: High trialability makes farmers more willing to try a new seed.

meaning_ko: 두 배로 오래, 두 배 길이의
example_en: The second film was twice as long as the first.

meaning_ko: 기록이 충분히 남아 있지 않은, 자료가 부족한
example_en: Historians are recovering the lives of under-documented workers.

meaning_ko: 화려하지 않은, 볼품없는, 수수한
example_en: Most scientific work is slow and unglamorous.

meaning_ko: 해석되지 않은, 가공되지 않은(있는 그대로의)
example_en: Sensors deliver uninterpreted data that someone must still explain.

meaning_ko: 체계적이지 않은, 산발적인, 두서없는
example_en: His notes were unsystematic and hard to follow.

meaning_ko: 거꾸로, 뒤집혀
example_en: The map was hanging upside down on the wall.

meaning_ko: 효용 극대화(만족을 가장 크게 하려는 행동)
example_en: Standard economics assumes utility maximization by every consumer.

meaning_ko: (위험을 무릅쓰고) ~에 들어가 보다, ~에 발을 들이다
example_en: Few travelers venture into the desert alone.

meaning_ko: 악순환
example_en: Skipping sleep to study creates a vicious cycle.

meaning_ko: 화상 채팅(하기)
example_en: They keep in touch by video chatting every weekend.

meaning_ko: 시각적인 요소(면), 겉으로 보이는 부분 — visual aspect 의 복수형
example_en: The visual aspects of a dish shape our first impression of it.

meaning_ko: 준비 운동을 했다, (음식을) 데웠다, (분위기가) 달아올랐다 — warm up 의 과거형
example_en: The runners warmed up before the race began.

meaning_ko: 생활 방수의, 물이 잘 스미지 않는
example_en: This watch is water-resistant but not fully waterproof.

meaning_ko: 약한 유대(자주 만나지 않는 느슨한 인간관계)
example_en: Weak ties often bring news about jobs that close friends never hear about.

meaning_ko: 공들여 잘 만든, 정교하게 쓴
example_en: A well-crafted essay leads the reader step by step.

meaning_ko: ~에 관하여, ~와 관련하여
example_en: The rules differ with respect to age.

meaning_ko: ~을 확대해 보다, ~에 초점을 맞춰 자세히 다루다
example_en: The report zooms in on one small farming village.
